# Vidmark 1.4.4
- Shows chapter and question activity, public agent updates, and separate staged and saved counts during app-started course builds. - Adds a display-only progress tool for Codex, Claude, and in-app coordinators. Progress instructions remain locally customizable. - Displays Claude's public live responses without exposing thinking or tool payloads. - Keeps incomplete drafts distinct from successful saves, including after cancellation or validation errors.

# Vidmark 1.4.3
- Renders Markdown in chapter lessons and generated study guides, including clickable citations, headings, lists, code blocks, and tables. - Styles course content for light and dark themes, with scrollable wide tables and code blocks. - Keeps shared content safe: raw HTML and non-web links are blocked, and remote images open only when clicked. - Preserves saved course content, notes, and provider preferences.

# Vidmark 1.4.2
- Fixes provider names and status text that were difficult to read in dark mode. - Uses a white OpenAI logo in dark mode while preserving Claude's brand color. - Makes selected provider cards follow the current theme, including the in-app agent icon. - Retains the selection border and keyboard focus indicator in both themes.
